description: Navigate a build_ssn_viewer .ssnv bundle and emit compact JSON summaries of clusters and their metadata at a chosen similarity threshold.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.help: An SSN viewer bundle (.ssnv) produced by build_ssn_viewer.py.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.help: Similarity threshold to cut the network at (higher = finer clusters). Omit or pass 'inf' for one cluster per connected component. Required for the 'clusters' and 'cluster' modes.

parameters.name: Cluster Id
parameters.help: Cluster id to describe (see the 'clusters' mode). For the 'cluster' mode.

parameters.name: Node
parameters.help: Node id/name to describe or locate. For the 'cluster' and 'node' modes.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.help: Write JSON to this file. Default: stdout.

advanced_parameters.name: Min Size
advanced_parameters.help: Only report clusters with at least this many members (clusters mode).

advanced_parameters.name: Top N
advanced_parameters.help: Bound list output: at most this many clusters, category values, etc.

advanced_parameters.name: Members
advanced_parameters.help: Include the full member id list in the 'cluster' mode output.
